replacements.old:
Their Definitions~1--2 and Remark~3 require exact predictor recovery
after one deletion request. Our contract additionally specifies the
state for subsequent requests at the remaining horizon and charges
all usable private information, including tickets.
replacements.new:
Their main Definitions~1--2 and Remark~3 require exact predictor recovery
after one deletion request; their threshold construction also supports
multiple requests (Appendix~B.1). Our distinction is the designated
canonical state for subsequent requests at the remaining horizon, with
all usable private information charged, including tickets.
replacements.reason: Avoid implying ticketed unlearning excludes multi-shot schemes.
